Dr. Ravi Shinde, leading Chiropractor in Thane, Mumbai, & Pune. We offer holistic, drug-free relief for all your body pain.

Specializing in: back pain, neck pain, sciatica, lumbar/cervical spondylosis, migraines, vertigo, frozen shoulder, sports injuries, and joint/muscle pain.

Dr. Shinde utilizes advanced Chiropractic care alongside Osteopathic (Osteopractic), Acupuncture, Dorn Therapy, Physiotherapy, and Ayurveda for complete healing and bone adjustment.

Book online: www.eka.care/doctor/dr-ravi-shinde
